what: Pins of the delivery arms on the frontier Harbor path (scripts/frontier-harbor/delivery.py): the gstack commit the skill arm installs and the Bun it installs with, gstack's unattended session, the fixed told sentence per host and kind with its sha256. tests/frontier-delivery.test.ts checks every sha256 here.

gstack.bun_source: GSTACK_BUN_TESTED in bin/gstack-bun-version.sh at the commit, the supported minimum (lib/install-verdict.ts refuses an unattended session below it)
gstack.session_note: gstack's unattended mode. GSTACK_CAPY is never set, so admission checks only the Bun minimum (lib/install-verdict.ts header at the commit). GSTACK_EPHEMERAL keeps no analytics or approval records. The state root is outside /work.
